interface: assess(text) preserves frozen prior_v2 receipt and adds delta_representation_review_holds plus pending_dependency_queue; no component integration/cropping.
rules: Exact password-wall plus Password prompt and recognized navigation/footer-only context. Unknown authored text causes queue-only.
Resource-only PDF/video/infographic access grammar requires every nonempty line recognized; unknown meaningful text prevents automatic role hold.
Explicit empty assessment heading through recognized attribution/reference boundary or EOF, allowing only known prerequisite/test boilerplate. Unknown content becomes queue-only.
Practice contains only2..12 bare options then ShowAnswer single letter, no in-block or immediate preceding prompt cue; scoped relation review hold, never reconstructed question.
Named media/comparison/required-context references become pending dependencies only; existence/necessity never inferred and no permanent book rejection.
negative_controls: Complete guides, contextual captions, substantive chapter introductions, poetry, optional media, meaningful assessment content, actual preceding/in-block question and explanatory answers.
limits: Literal role heuristics, not exhaustive completeness proof. Novel access/heading/content grammars remain unclassified or queued.
An implicit prompt located outside the immediate preceding line can remain ambiguous; downstream source-context review must adjudicate, no crop or quality/admission claim.
All inheritedv1/v2 holds preserved, including documented limits. Zero new holds never proves quality.
Component grants/generation/ancestry and factual risks remain separate. No unmarked-humanity clearance.
authorized_development: Only exact141 already-verdict-reviewed captures under30sec/256MBRSS/8MBmetadata and2MBtext. Extra seen71 excluded. Failed400/sample/verdicts unchanged; no newdraw/fullsource application.
